message: The proof-strategy.md does not include an explicit non-vacuity section addressing GOD RULE 2 (No Vacuum Verus Proofs) or GOD RULE 3 (No Unbounded TLA+ Math). While Verus and TLA+ are genuinely not_applicable with strong evidence for this P1 bead, a brief non-vacuity statement confirming that all Kani harnesses will use kani::any() (not hardcoded inputs, per GOD RULE 1) and that model_bounds are concrete would strengthen the plan. The obligations file already specifies model_bounds and assumptions per obligation.
required_fix: Add a Non-Vacuity section to proof-strategy.md confirming Kani harnesses will use kani::Arbitrary/kani::any() per GOD RULE 1, and noting that the non-applicable Verus/TLA+ lanes do not create vacuum-proof risk since no proofs are planned in those verifiers. Non-blocking: addressed implicitly by obligation model_bounds fields.
